name: uptime-slo-monitor
description: Self-hosted uptime & SLO monitor: probes live endpoints, computes SLIs over rolling windows, tracks error-budget burn, fires multi-window multi-burn-rate alerts, exposes Prometheus metrics, and serves a public status page.

scripts.test: tsx --test tests/config.test.ts tests/slo.test.ts tests/alerts.test.ts tests/probeAuth.test.ts tests/probe.test.ts tests/state.test.ts tests/uptime.test.ts tests/incidents.test.ts
